basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 28-year-old bisexual female who recently moved to Victoria, BC. I've been exploring the area and trying to settle in, but making new friends has been a bit challenging, especially within the queer community. My interests include streaming video games, especially 'Genshin Impact', and I love watching content by streamers like xQc. I work as a graphic designer, which allows me to work flexible hours, so I'm often online in the afternoons and evenings. I'm currently in a relationship, and my partner is wonderful, but they're the only queer person I know here. Looking forward to connecting with more like-minded people!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied it in college and worked in the field for several years. I'm self-taught in digital art and love exploring new software and techniques. My knowledge of video games and streaming culture comes from years of being an avid gamer and following various Twitch streamers.
